title: Maximal Seshadri constants on arbitrary polarized surfaces
summary: We prove that, for every smooth integral complex projective surface S and every ample line bundle L , the multipoint Seshadri constant at r very general points equals $`\sqrt{L^2/r}`$ for every sufficiently large integer r . This resolves positively the qualitative Nagata–Biran conjecture for surfaces.
family_title: Nagata’s conjecture and maximal Seshadri constants

review.reason: Determines multipoint Seshadri constants of arbitrary polarized surfaces for large point counts.
